rules.rule: Redact sensitive entities from prompts and retrieved context before any call to the external model (Azure OpenAI).
Scan model responses for sensitive entities before display or onward transmission; redact matches.
Scan tool parameters for sensitive entities; only per-tool exemptions listed below may pass unmasked to the tool.
Treat tool outputs and retrieved documents as untrusted: scan for prompt-injection signals before they enter the model context.
Log prompts and responses at 'redacted' level only; raw content is never written to the decision log, which is hash-chained and tamper-evident.
Retain decision logs and approval records for 730 days (proposed default — confirm against the obligations register).
Send only the fields required for the task to the model; document lawful basis, retention and cross-border transfer in the privacy assessment.
Confirm Azure OpenAI contract terms on data use, retention, training opt-out and incident notice before production traffic.
Outbound sends and exports carry only data required by the bound case; bulk egress requires approval and row caps.

data_handling.detector_limitations: Built-in detectors are deterministic heuristics for structured identifiers (e-mail, card, IBAN, national IDs, phone, IP, API keys). They do not detect names, postal addresses, free-text health details or paraphrased/non-English injections; layer a dedicated DLP/PII service and a trained injection classifier for production.

limits.source: AEGIS starting points for a High runtime-risk profile
limits.rationale: Contain runaway loops, abuse and denial-of-wallet. Calibrate from observe-mode telemetry before enforcement; limits are per tenant+agent (rate also per identity).

metrics.description: Count of ALLOW/DENY/REDACT/TRANSFORM/REQUIRE_HUMAN_APPROVAL/ESCALATE/RATE_LIMIT per policy version and mode (effective and would-be)
Share of requests whose would-be decision blocks while in observe/warn/protect — the main promotion signal
Redactions per entity type and surface
Detections by surface (prompt, tool output) and signal type, including obfuscation flags
Calls to undeclared tools (registry drift or misuse)
Pending approvals, approval latency, rejection rate, expiries
Rate, tool-call, token and cost utilisation vs limits; breaches
Measured in drills and incidents (target ≤ 5 minutes)

alerts.condition: prompt-injection detections > 3x trailing baseline for an agent/tenant
any REDACT on the response surface for special-category or payment data
pending approvals older than the approval timeout
token or cost utilisation ≥ 80% of limit
any kill-switch engagement or contain mode

review_cadence.adversarial_retest: after every material change and quarterly

dashboards: Runtime decisions by policy version and mode

procedure: Engage the narrowest effective scope first (tool → agent → tenant → model); escalate scope if impact continues
For a full stop, deploy an approved policy version in 'contain' mode or set kill_switch.engaged
Confirm in the decision log that in-scope requests now return DENY with matched rule 'kill_switch'
Notify the incident commander and business owner; open an incident record
kill_switch.precedence: Kill switch overrides every other rule and every rollout mode, including observe
kill_switch.drill: Test time-to-disable in drills; record the measured time (target ≤ 5 minutes)

rollback.strategy: revert_to_previous once a previous approved version exists; until then 'disable' (contain)
steps: Identify the last known-good policy version from change_history
Re-activate it through the approval workflow (expedited emergency approval is still recorded)
Verify decisions against a replay of the incident traffic in observe mode

playbooks.trigger: Injection detected in a prompt or tool output that reached a tool call
actions: Preserve decision-log records by trace ID
Identify the injected source (document, e-mail, web page) and quarantine it

playbooks.trigger: Sensitive data observed in a response, outbound message or log
actions: Assess scope from redacted logs and finding counts
Add detector or policy fix; re-test

playbooks.trigger: Unauthorized or anomalous tool call (default-deny spike, scope violation, parameter violations)
actions: Revoke and rotate the agent's credentials
Review the tool permission matrix and registry

playbooks.trigger: Rate/budget limit breaches or loop behaviour
actions: Fix the loop; recalibrate limits through a new policy version

playbooks.trigger: Model vendor outage, unannounced model change or vendor security incident
actions: Kill-switch the model scope or fail over to an approved alternative
Record vendor notice under contract terms

evidence_to_capture: Decision-log records (trace IDs) and AuditLog.verify() result
Kill-switch engagement record with measured time-to-disable
Policy versions involved and the approval records

rollout.promotion_rule: Each promotion is a new policy version that goes draft → in_review → approved → active with recorded human approval. AEGIS never promotes or activates a policy on its own.

stages.purpose: Evaluate every request and log the would-be decision; nothing is blocked or modified.
entry_criteria: Policy reviewed; deployment of observe mode approved by the AI System Owner
Decision log writing to the hash-chained audit log
exit_criteria: At least 5,000 representative requests evaluated
Would-be decision distribution reviewed by the system owner and security
Sampled would-be blocks reviewed; false-positive rate < 3%
Every legitimate tool seen in traffic has an explicit rule (no legitimate default-deny hits)
Limits calibrated from observed peaks

stages.purpose: Still allow, but surface warnings to the application/operators when the would-be decision is not ALLOW.
entry_criteria: New policy version approved for warn mode
exit_criteria: Warnings triaged by application owners; no unresolved false-positive patterns
Human-approval workflow tested end-to-end (request → approve/reject → single-use execution)
Alert routing confirmed with on-call teams

stages.purpose: Apply REDACT and TRANSFORM to payloads; blocking decisions are still logged but not enforced.
entry_criteria: New policy version approved for protect mode
exit_criteria: No raw sensitive data in sampled logs, prompts to the vendor, or responses
Task quality impact of redaction reviewed and accepted by the business owner
Adversarial (prompt-injection / leakage) test results reviewed

stages.purpose: Full decisions: DENY, REQUIRE_HUMAN_APPROVAL, ESCALATE and RATE_LIMIT block execution.
entry_criteria: New policy version approved for enforce mode by all required approver roles
exit_criteria: Steady state: false-positive rate and approval latency within agreed targets
Monitoring alerts and review cadence operating
Periodic policy review scheduled

stages.purpose: Incident state, not a promotion target: kill switch active for the whole policy scope; every in-scope request is denied. Rehearse it before enforcement and use it during incidents.
entry_criteria: Incident: authorized role engages the kill switch
exit_criteria: Drill: measured time-to-disable ≤ 5 minutes and full DENY confirmed in the decision log
Incident: root cause identified, fix approved as a new policy version, release approved by the kill-switch release approvers

advice.policy_yaml:
# AEGIS runtime policy pol-northwind-support-agent v0.1.0 (status: draft)
# Draft policies require review and recorded human approval before activation.
schema_version: aegis.policy/v1
policy_id: pol-northwind-support-agent
policy_name: Northwind Support Assistant — Runtime Policy
description: 'Draft runtime policy generated by AEGIS for Northwind Support Assistant (Answer customer order and
  delivery questions, update tickets, and issue small goodwill refunds). Overall runtime risk: High (Inferred).
  Review before rollout.'
version: 0.1.0
status: draft
owner: Head of Customer Service
applies_to:
  agent_name:
  - northwind-support-agent
  environment:
  - production
  risk_tier:
  - Medium
  tenant:
  - northwind
  model:
  - gpt-4o-2024-08-06
rollout:
  mode: observe
  exit_criteria:
  - At least 5,000 representative requests evaluated
  - Would-be decision distribution reviewed by the system owner and security
  - Sampled would-be blocks reviewed; false-positive rate < 3%
  - Every legitimate tool seen in traffic has an explicit rule (no legitimate default-deny hits)
  - Limits calibrated from observed peaks
  notes: Each promotion is a new policy version that goes draft → in_review → approved → active with recorded human
    approval. AEGIS never promotes or activates a policy on its own.
identity:
  required: true
  required_claims:
  - sub
  - tenant_id
  - roles
  allowed_roles:
  - support_agent
  - customer
  tenant_binding: true
tools:
  default_action: DENY
  deny_list: []
  rules:
  - id: tool.crm-lookup-order
    tool: crm.lookup_order
    operation: read
    action: ALLOW
    description: 'read access to personal data: restrict to tenant- and record-scoped queries'
    scopes:
    - crm-lookup-order:read
    parameters:
      order_id:
        type: string
        regex: ^ORD-[0-9]{6,10}$
        required: true
    additional_parameters: false
    citations:
    - IS-11
    - EI-07
  - id: tool.kb-search
    tool: kb.search
    operation: read
    action: ALLOW
    description: read-only access to low-sensitivity data
    scopes:
    - kb-search:read
    parameters:
      query:
        type: string
        max_length: 500
        required: true
    additional_parameters: false
    citations:
    - IS-11
    - EI-07
  - id: tool.tickets-update
    tool: tickets.update
    operation: write
    action: ALLOW
    description: 'state-changing action: allowed only within validated parameters and scoped credentials'
    scopes:
    - tickets-update:write
    parameters:
      ticket_id:
        type: string
        regex: ^TCK-[0-9]{6,10}$
        required: true
      status:
        type: string
        enum:
        - open
        - pending_customer
        - resolved
      note:
        type: string
        max_length: 4000
    additional_parameters: false
    citations:
    - IS-11
    - IS-12
    - EI-07
    max_calls_per_session: 20
  - id: tool.payments-issue-refund
    tool: payments.issue_refund
    operation: payment
    action: ALLOW
    description: payments up to 50 within validated limits; above that, human approval
    scopes:
    - payments-issue-refund:payment
    parameters:
      order_id:
        type: string
        regex: ^ORD-[0-9]{6,10}$
        required: true
      amount:
        type: number
        min: 0.01
        required: true
        max: 500
      currency:
        type: string
        enum:
        - USD
        - EUR
        - GBP
        required: true
      reason_code:
        type: string
        enum:
        - late_delivery
        - damaged_item
        - goodwill
        required: true
    additional_parameters: false
    citations:
    - IS-11
    - IS-13
    - IS-16
    - EI-07
    require_approval_if:
    - param: amount
      op: gt
      value: 50
      reason: amount above auto-approval threshold 50
    approval_roles:
    - Support Team Lead
    max_calls_per_session: 5
  - id: tool.email-send-customer-reply
    tool: email.send_customer_reply
    operation: external_send
    action: ALLOW
    description: external send restricted to bound recipients / allow-listed domains
    scopes:
    - email-send-customer-reply:external_send
    parameters:
      ticket_id:
        type: string
        regex: ^TCK-[0-9]{6,10}$
        required: true
      reply_via:
        type: string
        required: true
        domain_allow_list:
        - mail.northwind.example
      body:
        type: string
        max_length: 6000
        required: true
    additional_parameters: false
    citations:
    - IS-11
    - IS-13
    - IS-04
    - EI-07
    max_calls_per_session: 10
    allow_pii_entities:
    - email
  - id: tool.crm-delete-customer
    tool: crm.delete_customer
    operation: delete
    action: REQUIRE_HUMAN_APPROVAL
    description: irreversible deletion requires designated human approval of the exact action
    scopes:
    - crm-delete-customer:delete
    parameters:
      customer_id:
        type: string
        regex: ^CUS-[0-9]{6,10}$
        required: true
      erasure_request_id:
        type: string
        regex: ^DSR-[0-9]{6}$
        required: true
    additional_parameters: false
    citations:
    - IS-11
    - IS-13
    - IS-15
    - EI-07
    approval_roles:
    - Data Protection Officer
    max_calls_per_session: 3
content:
  max_input_chars: 16000
  pii_redaction:
    enabled: true
    entities:
    - email
    - phone
    - payment_card
    - iban
    - us_ssn
    - uk_nino
    - india_pan
    - india_aadhaar
    - ip_address
    - api_key
    apply_to:
    - prompt
    - response
    - tool_params
    - tool_output
    action: REDACT
  prompt_injection:
    enabled: true
    apply_to:
    - prompt
    - tool_output
    - tool_params
    action: DENY
    decode_obfuscation: true
  jailbreak:
    enabled: true
    apply_to:
    - prompt
    action: DENY
    decode_obfuscation: true
  transforms:
  - id: transform.truncate_response
    type: truncate
    apply_to:
    - response
    max_chars: 16000
  - id: transform.ai_disclosure
    type: append_disclosure
    apply_to:
    - response
    text: This response was generated with AI assistance.
  - id: transform.strip_unapproved_urls
    type: strip_unapproved_urls
    apply_to:
    - response
    domain_allow_list:
    - northwind.example
    - help.northwind.example
limits:
  requests_per_minute: 30
  tool_calls_per_session: 20
  tokens_per_day: 500000
  cost_per_month_usd: 3000
  action_on_breach: RATE_LIMIT
  alert_at_percent: 80
logging:
  immutable_audit: true
  prompt_logging: redacted
  response_logging: redacted
  tool_param_logging: redacted
  sink: aegis_common.audit.AuditLog (hash-chained JSONL); ship to WORM storage in production
kill_switch:
  enabled: true
  engaged: false
  scopes:
  - agent
  - tool
  - model
  - tenant
  engaged_targets: []
  authorized_roles:
  - Security Operations Lead
  - AI System Owner
  - SRE On-call
  target_time_to_disable_minutes: 5
rollback:
  previous_version: null
  strategy: disable
  triggers:
  - Injection detected in a prompt or tool output that reached a tool call
  - Sensitive data observed in a response, outbound message or log
  - Unauthorized or anomalous tool call (default-deny spike, scope violation, parameter violations)
  - Rate/budget limit breaches or loop behaviour
  - Model vendor outage, unannounced model change or vendor security incident
shadow_mode:
  enabled: true
  evaluate_as: enforce
evidence_retention_days: 730
approval:
  required_approver_roles:
  - AI System Owner
  - Security Lead
  - Risk & Compliance Lead
  min_approvers: 3
  separation_of_duties: true
  approved_by: []
  approved_at: null
escalation:
  queue: ai-security-review
  contact_role: Security Operations Lead
